title: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1) This Act may be called the North‑West
Province Public Service Commission Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Definitions

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
2. Definitions.‑In this Act, unless the context otherwise
requires, the following expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively
assigned to them, that is to say‑
(a) "Commission"
means the North‑West Frontier Province Public Service Commission ;
(b) "Government"
means the Government of the North‑West Frontier Province ;
(c) "member" means
member of the Commission and Includes the Chairman thereof ;
(d) "prescribed"
means prescribed by rules made under this Act;
(e) "Province" means
the Province of the North‑West Frontier.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Composition of commission

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
3. Composition of Commission.‑(1)
There shall be a Commission for the Province to be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Public Service Commission.
(2) The Commission shall
consist of three members, one of whom shall be the Chairman, to be appointed by
the Governor on such terms and .conditions as may be prescribed.
(3) Not less than one‑half
of the members shall be persons who are at the time of appointment, or who have
been at some time before appoint went, in the service of Pakistan.
(4) Where the person appointed
as member was, immediately before his appointment,
in the service of Pakistan, his right as a person. in the service of Pakistan
shall not, subject to his appointment and service as such member, be affected.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Term of office

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
4. Term of office.‑(I) A member shall hold office for a term
of three years from the date on which he enters upon his office, and shall be
eligible for re‑appointment for such further period or periods as may,
from time to time, be specified :
Provided that all such members
who were holding office immediately before the commencement of the Constitution
of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, shall continue to hold office for the
unexpired period of the term for which they were appointed.
(2) A member may resign his
office by writing under his hand addressed to the Governor.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Termination of appointment of members

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
5. Termination of appointment of member.‑Notwithstanding
anything to the contrary contained in section 4, the Governor may, for reasons
to be recorded, terminate the appointment of any member before the expiration
of his term of office.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Functions of the commission

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
6. Functions of the Commission.‑‑The functions "of
the Commission, shall be‑
(a) to conduct tests and
examinations for recruitment to such services and posts in connection with the
affairs of the Province as may be prescribed;
(b) to advise Government on
such matters as may be prescribed relating to the terms and conditions of
service of persons who hold civil posts in connection with the affairs of the
Province; and
(c) such other functions as may
be prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Officers and servants of the commission

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
7. officers and servants of the
Commission.‑Subject to such
general or special orders as Government may from time to time give, the
Commission may appoint such officers and servants as it considers necessary for
the efficient performance of its functions, on such terms and conditions as it
may determine.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Validation

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
8. Validation.‑Anything
done or any 'action taken or any advice given, after the repeal of the Interim
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and before the commencement of
this Act, by the Commission constituted under the said Constitution shall be
deemed to have been done or taken or given in the exercise of the powers
conferred by or under this Act, as if this Act were in force on the date on
which such thing was done or such action was taken or such advice was given.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Act 1973
sections.description:
Power to make rules

ACT XIX OF 1973
ACT XIX OF 1973
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1973
9. Power to make rules.‑Government
may make rules for the purposes of carrying into effect the provisions of this
Act.
